newsitem.title: INDIA: India's United Front says no leader on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: India's United Front says no leader on Thursday.

text.p: India's United Front coalition will not choose a new leader to replace caretaker Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda at a meeting on Thursday, a spokesman said.

Jaipal Reddy said the alliance's decision-making Steering Committee would meet at 3 p.m. (0930 GMT) but was expected to adjourn due to the death in hospital on Thursday of veteran politician Biju Patnaik, a leader of Deve Gowda's Janata Dal party.
Patnaik, former chief minister of the eastern Indian state of Orissa, died on Thursday in a New Delhi hospital, local news agencies said. He was 81.
Reddy said the United Front Steering Committee would discuss changing its leadership but not take a final decision.
"It will be discussed but it will be consultations. No decision will be taken today," he told Reuters by telephone.

Deve Gowda resigned last Friday after losing a confidence vote in the lower house of parliament. The Congress party, which triggered his defeat by withdrawing its vital support, has said it would support a new United Front government provided the centre-left alliance chose a new leader.
